title: ESP returning to her music
summary: The ESP moved back into her music as she played more; she sees less now.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Once you got back into music and were not praying as constantly as you had been, was there a change in anything?

Yes, there was a little change because you see, what I was trying to tell you, that ESP was in my music and the more music I played and the more jobs, it's not so much now, just a little. Maybe once or twice a year or three times a year. See, it's getting back into the music again, but it was on the outside. That's the reason why I told you that story so you'd know what had happened. See I had very good - I was better than Dixon, that woman in Washington, but I didn't know it; see, it was in my music.

It's going back in. I'm seeing less and less of these things but if anything important - I had a flash about 2 or 3 months ago. I've forgotten what it was. A strange thing used to happen to me too, say for instance I've never been to your house and all of a sudden maybe one day I could see you walking into your house, or I could see you. You know? That used to happen, things like that. They were just terrible for a while. I could hear people talking about me. Lorraine and Dizzy were saying something one day - this was before I began really playing.
